abilities.name: Team Builder
abilities.en: You may retry a Pokédex search once per encounter. Additionally, Battle Items only need 1 of each Apricorn on the recipe to craft.

abilities.name: Competitive Edge
abilities.en: Your Strong Pokémon gain +1 initiative.

abilities.name: Sweet Scent
abilities.en: During capture attempts at Apricorn Trees, replace 1 status symbol with 1 regular hit.

abilities.name: Natural Remedy
abilities.en: When you attack with a Grass-type or Fairy-type move, the user heals for half the damage dealt, rounded up.

abilities.name: Detailed Sketch
abilities.en: After defeating a wild Pokémon, you may teach its move to any Pokémon in your party regardless of their learnable move types.

abilities.name: Finished Masterpiece
abilities.en: If your party has a move of every type, all your moves gain +2 attack strength. Typeless moves and abilities act as wildcards and can be considered as any type towards achieving this effect.

abilities.name: Portable Tent
abilities.en: After any battle, fully restore a Pokémon in your party.

abilities.name: Holding Capacity
abilities.en: Your Pokémon can now hold and use up to two Held Items so long as they are not the same item.

abilities.name: Lady Luck
abilities.en: During all your rolls, critical hits deal +2 damage but status symbols deal -1 damage.

abilities.name: Natural Charisma
abilities.en: When you attack with a Normal-type or Dark-type move, status symbols deal +1 damage.

abilities.name: Bird Whistle
abilities.en: You may fly to a village from any tile by discarding 1 Apricorn. There cannot be any Team Galactic Grunts on the target village.

abilities.name: Evasive Manoeuvres
abilities.en: Your Flying-type Pokémon take no damage from attacks that would only deal 2 or less damage to them.

abilities.name: Super Training
abilities.en: After defeating a wild Pokémon, gain 2 extra Journey Points.

abilities.name: Fighting Spirit
abilities.en: During your turn whilst outside of battle, you may inflict the Burned status on your Pokémon. Replace the effect of Burned when applied to your Fighting-type Pokémon: Increase the total damage you deal by 2.

abilities.name: Catching Frenzy
abilities.en: After capturing a Bug-type Pokémon, gain 2 extra Journey Points and immediately start an extra turn. Cannot be repeated on the extra turn.

abilities.name: Bug Specialist
abilities.en: Your Bug-type Pokémon gain +2 initiative and +1 attack strength to their Bug-type moves.

abilities.name: Ingredient Expert
abilities.en: You may freely convert the Apricorns in your bag for different Apricorns of the same tier.

abilities.name: Masterwork Stew
abilities.en: Costs 1 of every Apricorn: Your Pokémon gain +1 attack strength to their moves that are the same type as them. Lasts until the end of battle.

abilities.name: Stamp Collector
abilities.en: When claiming any stamp reward, you may claim the reward twice.

abilities.name: Pokémon Collector
abilities.en: The moves gained from stamp rewards can be added to your party as Pokémon instead. Additionally, when you discard any Pokémon or moves, add them to your stamp rewards move pool.

abilities.name: Offering Thief
abilities.en: When another trainer makes a Shrine Offering, gain the Apricorn they discard.

abilities.name: Intimidating Posture
abilities.en: Your Dark-type Pokémon and Poison-type Pokémon take 2 less damage from attacks.

abilities.name: Temporal Devotion
abilities.en: When unlocked, become a Follower of Dialga for the rest of the game. Your Follower token always counts as 2 of the cards needed for Dialga's Play 3 effect.

abilities.name: Chosen of Dialga
abilities.en: When unlocked, search the Legendary Pokémon deck for Dialga and add it to your party. Temporarily decrease the health and initiative of Dialga by 1 for each Shard you are currently missing or for every 3 Ultra Beasts undefeated.

abilities.name: Apex Hatchling
abilities.en: When unlocked, search the Weak Pokémon deck for a Dragon-type Pokémon and add it to your party. This Pokémon receives the Apex Dragon held item which cannot be unequipped. Your Apex Dragon costs an extra 5 Journey Points to evolve at all stages.

abilities.name: Apex Strength
abilities.en: Your Apex Dragon now gains +6 health, +2 initiative and +1 attack strength to its moves.

abilities.name: Planning Ahead
abilities.en: After a battle, you may use any movement you have remaining but cannot interact with anything else this turn.

abilities.name: Opportune Strike
abilities.en: When you start a battle against a wild Pokémon, if you have not moved anywhere yet this turn, your first attack against them deals double damage.

abilities.name: Shrine Keeper
abilities.en: When you make a Shrine Offering, draw 1 extra Shrine Event card. This only gives you more choices, you still play the same number of Shrine Event cards as you would normally.

abilities.name: Legendary Protector
abilities.en: When Beast Boost triggers, your Legendary Pokémon heal 3 damage, reset their battle fatigue to 0 and increase the attack strength of their next attack by 2.

abilities.name: Wishing Star
abilities.en: Your Pokémon heal 1 extra damage whenever they are healed by any effect.

abilities.name: Day Dreamer
abilities.en: During your turn whilst outside of battle, you may inflict the Drowsy status on your Pokémon. Replace the effect of Drowsy when applied to your Fairy-type Pokémon: At the end of your turns during battle, heal 1 damage.

abilities.name: Super Rod
abilities.en: During capture attempts at Apricorn Reefs, replace 1 status symbol with 1 regular hit. After capturing a wild Pokémon at an Apricorn Reef, roll and then add a Catch Size dice to them.

abilities.name: Catch of the Day
abilities.en: Your Pokémon now gain health equal to their Catch Size. Additionally, for the cost of 2 Journey Points: Increase the Catch Size of a Pokémon in your party to its next level.

abilities.name: Pick Apricorn
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may gain 1 Apricorn from an Apricorn Tree you are standing on.

abilities.name: Trimmed Form
abilities.en: Your Grass-type Pokémon and Rock-type Pokémon gain +3 initiative but -2 health.

abilities.name: Amulet Coin
abilities.en: After capturing or defeating a wild Pokémon, gain double the amount of Apricorns.

abilities.name: Cherish Ball
abilities.en: When unlocked, you receive the Cherish Ball. When the Cherish Ball is used to capture a wild Pokémon, it automatically captures that Pokémon. Additionally, if you release the captured Pokémon, you get the Cherish Ball back.

abilities.name: Trade Monopoly
abilities.en: When another trainer uses the current Ginkgo Trade, gain the Apricorns they discard.

abilities.name: Disposable Assets
abilities.en: Before attacking, you may discard 1 Apricorn to temporarily change the base attack strength of a move this turn to 4/5/6 based on the tier of the Apricorn used. For example, 1 Black Apricorn would be required to change the attack strength of a move to 6.

abilities.name: Ramp Up
abilities.en: When unlocked, you receive an Amplifier dice. For every status symbol you roll, increase your Amplifier dice by 1. You may reset the Amplifier dice to add its value as damage to any attack. Your Amplifier dice value persists between battles.

abilities.name: Amplifier Overload
abilities.en: When you attack with an Electric-type move, you may double the value of your Amplifier dice when its used. Afterwards, you can no longer use your Amplifier dice during this battle.

abilities.name: Unstable Magic
abilities.en: When inflicting any status effects, you may instead roll the status dice to inflict the new status effect it lands on.

abilities.name: Spell Caster
abilities.en: You may inflict additional status effects onto a target so long as the target does not have that status effect already. Additionally, your Ghost-type moves gain +1 attack strength.

abilities.name: Hiking Gear
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Mountain tiles in a row for free. Additionally, you can move onto any tile regardless of its elevation.

abilities.name: Sturdy Footing
abilities.en: Your Rock-type Pokémon and Ground-type Pokémon gain +4 health but -1 initiative.

abilities.name: Big Scoop
abilities.en: Whenever another trainer gains a Journey Stamp, you may instantly move to that trainer to challenge them to a battle. If you win the battle, you may also gain that Journey Stamp.

abilities.name: Equipment Check
abilities.en: During your turn whilst outside of battle, you may swap your taught moves between the Pokémon in your party. The Pokémon you give the move to must be able to learn it.

abilities.name: Gather Firewood
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may remove any Apricorn Tree from the map to add 3 Burned status effects to your bag as Firewood.

abilities.name: Burning Ignition
abilities.en: When you attack with a Fire-type move, you may inflict the Burned status effect and deal 2 damage to the opposing Pokémon by using 1 Firewood from your bag.

abilities.name: Noble Heritage
abilities.en: When unlocked, gain 7 Journey Points. Additionally, the Evolve Costs of your Pokémon are reduced by 2.

abilities.name: Hyper Potion
abilities.en: Once per battle, heal all damage and status effects from a non-fainted Pokémon in your party.

abilities.name: Surprise Attack
abilities.en: When you have Initiative Advantage, you may use it to go first regardless of actual initiative values.

abilities.name: Toxin Dart
abilities.en: Inflict either the Poisoned, Confused or Drowsy status effects on the opposing Pokémon whenever you use Initiative Advantage.

abilities.name: Weather Forecast
abilities.en: When unlocked, place the Weather Wheel in the middle of the arena on a Weather of your choice. Any trainer may change the Weather by discarding 3 Journey Points at a Shrine. All moves that match the Weather type gain +2 attack strength.

abilities.name: Utility Umbrella
abilities.en: Your Pokémon take 2 less damage from moves that match the current Weather.

abilities.name: Spatial Devotion
abilities.en: When unlocked, become a Follower of Palkia for the rest of the game. Your Follower token always counts as 2 of the cards needed for Palkia's Play 3 effect.

abilities.name: Chosen of Palkia
abilities.en: When unlocked, search the Legendary Pokémon deck for Palkia and add it to your party. Temporarily decrease the health and initiative of Palkia by 1 for each Shard you are currently missing or for every 3 Ultra Beasts undefeated.

abilities.name: Woodland Explorer
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Forest tiles in a row for free. Additionally, you may fly to Campsites from any tile by discarding 1 Apricorn.

abilities.name: Picnic Basket
abilities.en: When crafting an Apricorn Stew, you may gain the effect of another Apricorn Stew for free.

abilities.name: Renegade Devotion
abilities.en: When unlocked, become a Follower of Giratina for the rest of the game. Your Follower token always counts as 2 of the cards needed for Giratina's Play 3 effect.

abilities.name: Chosen of Giratina
abilities.en: When unlocked, search the Legendary Pokémon deck for Giratina and add it to your party. Temporarily decrease the health and initiative of Giratina by 1 for each Shard you are currently missing or for every 3 Ultra Beasts undefeated.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.en: Your Weak Pokémon can at most take 3 damage from a single attack.

abilities.name: Loyalty Card
abilities.en: When crafting a Battle Item, you may gain another Battle Item for free.

abilities.name: Pokémon Disguise
abilities.en: When attacking, you may use the signature move of the opposing Pokémon against them.

abilities.name: Uncanny Substitute
abilities.en: When unlocked, you receive the Substitute held item. The Pokémon with the Substitute held item attached may be switched in from your party just before any damage is applied from an opposing attack.

abilities.name: Egg Move
abilities.en: When evolving a Weak Pokémon, you may instead teach the move of its evolution to the pre-evolution as an Egg Move. This Pokémon can no longer evolve.

abilities.name: Almost Perfect IVs
abilities.en: Your Pokémon that were taught an Egg Move gain +5 health and +5 initiative.

abilities.name: Pokémon Ranch
abilities.en: You may use any locked party slots to store your Pokémon but these Pokémon cannot be used in battle. In the Ultra Burst campaign, you may store up to 2 Distortion Breach cards in each empty slot.

abilities.name: Trusty Companions
abilities.en: Your Moderate Pokémon gain +1 health and +1 initiative for each locked party slot that you unlock. In the Ultra Burst campaign, you get the maximum of +3 health and +3 initiative immediately.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Reach
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may interact with something from up to 2 tiles away.

abilities.name: Subtle Manipulation
abilities.en: When you attack with a Psychic-type or Ghost-type move, you may change the result of 1 dice rolled to any other value.

abilities.name: Roller Skates
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Plains tiles in a row for free. Additionally, non-Legendary wild Pokémon can now only flee after defeating two of your Pokémon.

abilities.name: Protective Gear
abilities.en: Your Pokémon can at most take 6 damage from a single attack.

abilities.name: Artifact Hunter
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may reveal 1 Special Hidden Spot anywhere on the map. If it is an Artifact, you may instantly move to it and attach it to a Pokémon in your party.

abilities.name: Artifact Expert
abilities.en: Your Artifacts gain +1 attack strength to their bonuses and cannot be taken by other trainers.

abilities.name: Field Observation
abilities.en: Once per turn, search at an Apricorn Tree, Apricorn Reef or Distortion Gate without starting a battle. You may now directly teach all the moves searched to any Pokémon in your party that can learn them.

abilities.name: Weakness Analysis
abilities.en: When attacking, your damage from positive type effectiveness is increased by 1.

abilities.name: Sunken Treasure
abilities.en: Once per turn whilst on an Ocean tile, shuffle the Hidden Spot discard pile and then draw the top Hidden Spot. Place the drawn Hidden Spot on the tile you are on, you may then interact with it as usual.

abilities.name: Scuba Dive
abilities.en: After you attack with a Water-type move, the user may switch out and then heal all status effects.

abilities.name: Wing Suit
abilities.en: You may move to adjacent tiles that are 2 or more elevations lower than your current tile. After doing so, you may move up to 4 additional tiles in a row so long as your elevation does not increase.

abilities.name: Air Superiority
abilities.en: Your Flying-type Pokémon gain +1 attack strength to all their moves so long as they are not against another Flying-type Pokémon.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 Ocean tiles in a row for free. Additionally, your Water-type Pokémon gain +1 initiative.

abilities.name: Butterfly Technique
abilities.en: When you attack with a Water-type move, you may change its type to either Bug-type or Flying-type.

abilities.name: Submarine Dive
abilities.en: If you are standing on an Ocean tile at the end of your turn, you may instantly move to any other Ocean tile.

abilities.name: Primordial Sea
abilities.en: During your battles, all Water-type moves gain +1 attack strength and all Water-type Pokémon take 1 less damage when attacked.

abilities.name: Magma Tunnels
abilities.en: If you are standing on a Mountain tile at the end of your turn, you may instantly move to any other Mountain tile.

abilities.name: Desolate Land
abilities.en: During your battles, all Fire-type moves gain +1 attack strength and all Fire-type Pokémon take 1 less damage when attacked.

abilities.name: Pokémon Thief
abilities.en: During a battle with another trainer, you can attempt to capture their Pokémon but with -2 to your capture rolls. The captured Pokémon keeps everything it currently has attached.

abilities.name: Blasting Off
abilities.en: When one of your Pokémon faints, deal 2 damage to the opposing Pokémon. If you are out of usable Pokémon, you may travel to any tile on the map and are automatically fully restored at the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Landmark Tour
abilities.en: When unlocked, place the Landmark Tour sheet in your hand. Once at each Artifact Legendary Location, stamp it on your Landmark Tour sheet to search for the Legendary Pokémon there and make a clone of its card. These cards become your Legendary Snaps and are kept next to your trainer area.

abilities.name: Holiday Album
abilities.en: You may teach the Legendary Snaps you have collected as moves to any Pokémon in your party that can learn them. Additionally, if you complete your Landmark Tour sheet, gain 30 Journey Points.

abilities.name: Swim Bike Run
abilities.en: Once per turn, you may move up to 2 non-Mountain tiles in a row for free.

abilities.name: Triple Threat
abilities.en: When your Pokémon knows moves of 3 different types, you may change the type of your attack to any of those 3 types. Works for Typeless moves too.

abilities.name: Eternal Devotion
abilities.en: When unlocked, replace your Follower token with the Follower of Arceus token for the rest of the game. A Follower of Arceus is counted as a Follower of all three Gods of Sinnoh at the same time.

abilities.name: Judgement of Arceus
abilities.en: After attacking, the opposing Pokémon faints if they have 2 or less health remaining.

abilities.name: Wilderness Expert
abilities.en: When you find an Apricorn Stash, gain 2 extra Apricorns of the same type and move 1 additional tile this turn.

abilities.name: Gale Force
abilities.en: When you attack with an Ice-type or Dragon-type move, you may add up to 2 status symbols to roll.

abilities.name: Civil Engineer
abilities.en: Costs 2 Journey Points: You may build Roads on any non-Ocean tiles you move onto this turn. All trainers can move through any number of interconnected Roads for 1 tile move. Roads are built by drawing them with the Pen tool.

abilities.name: Road Works
abilities.en: When your Steel-type Pokémon are switched in, increase the battle fatigue of the opposing Pokémon by 3 and prevent them from switching out or fleeing the battle.

abilities.name: Childhood Friends
abilities.en: Your Weak Pokémon gain +1 health and +1 initiative.

abilities.name: Career Options
abilities.en: When unlocked, draw 5 trainer cards from the deck and swap this card with one of the drawn cards. Triggers the "when unlocked" effects on the new trainer card.
